last.verdict: CoreWeave raised its 2026 outlook and backlog jumped to $132.5B, but rising interest costs and $37-39B of spending keep losses deep.

takeaways.label: Growth and guidance
takeaways.text: Revenue was $3.66B, up about 168% from a year ago and above the $3.45-3.6B target. Full-year 2026 revenue guidance rose to $13.0-13.3B.

takeaways.label: Backlog keeps swelling
takeaways.text: Contracted backlog reached about $132.5B, up from about $104B last quarter. Roughly $9B of customer prepayments and deposits are expected over the next three months.

takeaways.label: Debt costs weigh
takeaways.text: Net loss was $709M as interest expense hit $846M. Q4 interest is guided to $1.05-1.15B, and the company raised $4.2B in convertible notes.

takeaways.label: Spending stays huge
takeaways.text: 2026 capital spending is guided to $37-39B, with the low end raised, as capacity gets delivered sooner than planned. Adjusted operating margin was 10%, versus 16% a year ago.

history.verdict: Profit beat and a higher revenue outlook outweighed bigger spending plans and widening losses.

reasons.label: Profit far above plan
reasons.text: Adjusted operating income hit $128M, more than double the company's own ~$60M target.

reasons.label: Higher revenue outlook
reasons.text: 2026 revenue guidance rose to $12.4–13.2B; Q3 guide of $3.45–3.6B beat $3.43B consensus.

reasons.label: Backlog keeps ballooning
reasons.text: Contracted backlog reached about $104B, up 246% from a year earlier.
